answer_en_30s: My biggest deal was a renewal. / It was turning into a price fight. / So I moved the talk / to their growth plan. / We closed twelve point four million / over three years.
I want to sell a product / that changes how customers work. / {{COMPANY}} is that next step for me.
In my first ninety days at Acme, / I would learn the product / and book ten discovery meetings.
